methodology.hedgeModel: Fixed always-on short BTC perpetual proxy. hedge_btc = hedge_ratio * BTC spot exposure at each CCW roll.
methodology.rebalance: Hedge is rebalanced only at natural CCW roll boundaries and remains fixed during each cycle.
methodology.cyclePnl: pnl_total_hedged = pnl_underlying + pnl_call + pnl_hedge; pnl_hedge = -hedge_btc * (S_exit - S_entry).
methodology.sizing: Hedged capital path is recursively recomputed so each next cycle sizes BTC exposure from prior hedged capital.
methodology.preservedBaseline: Option selection, option entry source, theoretical fallback, and settlement are inherited from existing baseline trades.
